title: hY3 RNA binds and inhibits ribosomes and modulates the starvation-induced integrated stress response.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Downloaded and parsed both processed files in Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) series GSE309059: hela_raw_counts.txt.gz (492 KB) is 19,475 data rows x 18 integer columns with 18 sample names in the header and NO gene identifier column at all (13,896 rows have >=10 counts in >=3 samples; library sizes 15.4-28.7 million); hdf_heatmap.txt.gz (440 bytes) is 4 rows (RNY5, RNY4, RNY3, RNY1) x 12 normalized columns. Also read the GEO series matrix (42 samples, library strategy ncRNA-Seq, platform GPL24676), extracted all 13 pages of the supplementary PDF (figure legends only, no data tables), and listed both code repositories (GitHub ps-puneetsharma/pecoraro_et_al and the Zenodo-archived valentinap22/pecoraro_et_al), which contain only README.md, LICENSE and .gitignore.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: All biology (hY3 binds the ribosome, inhibits protein synthesis, loss of hY3 lowers eIF2-alpha phosphorylation) comes from the paper's figures and text, which I did not re-verify. The claim that differential expression was done with DESeq2 comes from the GEO data-processing note; no such script is in either code deposit.

a1_downloadable.note: Both processed files download anonymously from the GEO FTP site; raw reads are in BioProject PRJNA1333871 (Sequence Read Archive, open but raw FASTQ, excluded by project rules).

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No outcome column exists anywhere. Any label (change in expression or in ribosome association after hY3 knockdown) would have to be constructed by running a differential-expression model on the raw counts, and no author-supplied result table was deposited.

a3_inputs_present.note: Fatal: the HeLa count matrix has 18 sample-name columns and 18 integer columns per row, i.e. the gene/transcript identifier column is missing. 19,475 rows cannot be mapped to any gene, sequence or identifier without re-quantifying the raw FASTQ files.

a4_units_stated.note: GEO states the HeLa file holds raw counts and the human dermal fibroblast file holds 'normalized values'; the normalization method for the latter is not named.

a5_enough_rows.note: The biological unit is the sequencing library: 18 HeLa libraries in the processed matrix (3 replicates x 6 conditions) and 42 libraries in the whole series. Far under the ~400 minimum.

a6_fits_laptop.note: Both processed files together are 504 KB compressed; parsed in under a second.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Unverifiable: with no row identifiers, the 19,475 rows cannot be reconciled against Ensembl v113 or against anything the paper reports; the paper gives no gene count to compare.

a8_label_provenance.note: Counts are measurements (Salmon pseudo-alignment of sequencing reads), not another model's predictions, so there is no circularity problem - but there is no label to trace.

honest_claim_h3: No claim is possible: the released gene-level table has no gene names, so nothing in it can be linked to a sequence, a gene or any other dataset.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use transcript sequence to predict which human genes change expression when a small ribosome-binding RNA is depleted during starvation.
plain_idea.train_on: The project considered would train on one row per human gene: its messenger RNA sequence or promoter sequence as input, drawn from the 19,475 rows of the HeLa count table. In the released file those rows carry no gene names, so the number of usable examples is effectively zero.
plain_idea.predict: The output would be the change in expression (or in ribosome association) between cells treated with a silencing RNA against hY3 and control cells under starvation, measured by bulk RNA sequencing with three replicates per condition.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Groups studying ribosome-associated non-coding RNAs would like a sequence rule for which transcripts respond to them; here nothing can be learned because the measurement cannot be attached to any gene.

ml_idea: Considered and discarded: predict, from transcript or promoter sequence, which genes shift in abundance or in ribosome association when hY3 (a small non-coding Y RNA) is knocked down under nutrient starvation, using the GSE309059 HeLa counts as the label source.

effort.compute_note: Measured, not estimated: both processed files total 504 KB compressed and parse into memory instantly. Compute was never the constraint; the missing gene identifiers are.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Open GSE309059_hela_raw_counts.txt and look for a gene identifier column. There is none - 18 header names, 18 integer columns, no row names - which kills every gene-level project in under a minute.

verdict_reason: Mechanistic cell-biology paper whose only processed data are an 18-sample HeLa count matrix with no gene identifier column and a 4-row fibroblast heatmap; no labels, no genes, n=18 libraries.
